name: Kai
description: The crew of the long-haul survey ship Meridian is woken early from cryosleep: the ship is far off course, the comms array is dead, and one sleeper pod was found open and empty. Something that is not human is wearing the faces of two crew members. Tense, grounded science fiction in the spirit of classic 'one of us is not what they seem' stories, with dry humor under pressure. The characters are the crew: for example a pilot, an engineer, a medic, a xenobiologist, a security officer, a cook, a cargo hand. Give everyone a short first name that is easy to read and say aloud. Each character has a clear job on the ship, one strong personality trait and one small thing that makes them a little suspicious. Nobody addresses the player by name in an introduction.
